# E0334: a nested body embeds something other than a path into the source instance

A nested body may embed a path into the source instance, `{v0_0.meta, x: 1}`,
to copy the fields found there and add to them. It may embed nothing else.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	meta: {
		owner: string
	}
}
```

`ship/history/1.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	meta: {
		owner: string
		team:  string
	}
}

ForwardLens: (prev): {
	self: {
		meta: {
			defaults
			team: "unassigned"
		}
	}
}
```

`ship/tip.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	meta: {
		owner: string
		team:  string
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0334]: a nested body may embed only prev.<path>, to copy from it
  --> history/1.0.thema:11:4
   |
11 |             defaults
   |             ^^^^^^^^
   |
```
